Marissa — thanks for the overview. A few clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams:

1) SOC 2: Do you have a current Type II report and what is the coverage period? Redacted report is fine.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: Do you sign data processing agreements and have any BAA in place for PHI-handling workloads?
3) Incident response: what is your defined timeline for customer notification after confirmation of a data breach? Does Redwood commit to a 72-hour notification window or is it contract-dependent?
4) BCP/DR evidence: do you have recent tabletop/exercise summaries or RTO/RPO metrics we can review?
5) Vendor questionnaire: we'll send our standard security questionnaire — can you confirm who will own completion and whether you have a vendor portal?

We may also need a short NDA (procurement will push if required).

Thanks,
Amir Khan
Head of Security Operations
FintechCorp
amir.khan@fintechcorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-19T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — follow up & security items from today's demo

Amir — great questions. Short answers below, and attached are redacted artifacts to start the conversation.

1) SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Attached: SOC2-Type-II-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted).

2) GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR controls and will sign standard DPAs. For HIPAA, we offer BAAs for customers with covered workloads — Laura (cc'd) owns our BAA process.

3) Incident response / breach notification: Our incident response policy requires internal confirmation and triage within 24 hours of detection. Customer notification commitments are contract-dependent, but our standard practice is to issue initial customer notifications within 72 hours of confirmed unauthorized access affecting customer data. We'll work with you on contractual language if you require tighter windows.

4) BCP/DR evidence: Attached is a short executive summary of our BCP runbook and an IR runbook excerpt. We run annual tabletop exercises and quarterly ops drills; the most recent tabletop was 2025-11-12 (summary included in BCP-Runbook-Executive-Summary.pdf). Our typical RTO/RPO for critical inference endpoints is documented in the runbook excerpt.

5) Vendor questionnaire: We have a vendor portal and can intake questionnaires as either (A) portal upload, or (B) direct XLSX of your questionnaire (attached: Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-Init.xlsx). Laura will coordinate completion and can provide additional evidence as needed.

Next steps:
- I'll upload the artifacts to the shared drive link and send DocuSign NDA if procurement requests it.
- Laura, can you confirm availability for the Wed 3/24 10am PT call and own the questionnaire?

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment stubs: SOC2-Type-II-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted), BCP-Runbook-Executive-Summary.pdf, Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-Init.xlsx

Hi Amir — happy to own the questionnaire and run through any required artifacts on the 3/24 call. A few clarifications ahead of time:

- BAA: we can provide a standard BAA template; if FintechCorp requires additional clauses we'll route for legal review.
- Incident notification: operationally we aim to provide an initial customer-facing notification within 72 hours of confirming a breach; follow-ups depend on investigation scope. We can contractually tighten this for high-risk customers.
- BCP/DR evidence shared: attaching an IR runbook excerpt and the tabletop exercise summary (most recent tabletop 2025-11-12). If you'd like the full incident timeline templates or previous sanitized exercise logs we can provide them under NDA.
